meta.name: Prime fields · classical heuristic
meta.regime: No deliberately supplied special-form modulus; includes full relation generation and logarithm computation
meta.rules: Prime-field NFS bounds. Precomputation cost and per-target logarithm cost should not be mixed. Here L_X[α,c] = exp((c+o(1))(ln X)^α(ln ln X)^(1−α)); all logarithms in this definition are natural. Only compare entries with this cost scale, input domain and computational model. Polynomial and quasi-polynomial expressions without an extracted scalar are not ranked.
